about: Known strength impacts of bot features, for the ladder's drill-down (scripts/arena_ladder.py, G9-D9). A row is shown beside every changed feature whose name is in its 'features' list (the names are scripts/arena_ladder.py FEATURES). Rule (g9, 13 Nov 04:24 UTC): a row compares two configurations that differ only in that feature, or says in 'also_differs' what else differs. 'mean' is IMPs a board in favour of the configuration named first in 'compares'; null when the source gives no signed figure. Bench rows give the trick figure and the conversion at 3.8 IMPs a trick (E9-0) with 10% on the conversion in 'se'. Draft by dave; sam adds play and signal rows; g9 reviews. 'when': 'added' shows a row only where the parent lacks the feature, 'changed' only where both have it.

features: early play reading (from trick 1, before the deal list)
